visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic national-brokerage profile pages by OPENING on proof — the three brokers' faces and the firm's Google record with its trace — and then one reach control, rather than a license line over seven identical contact rows. Origin is short Quiet below the fold.
note: SITE-90 2026-09-12 (Matt fold redo). Order is Breadcrumb, AboutFaces (H1 About Ryan Realty · Bend, eyebrow, a real firm beat, three broker Cards with separate Avatars), V3Doors #reach as a REACH CONTROL (one call door at display scale carrying the live hours state, then text, email and the calendar as lighter links), V3Proof (the words, headline 'In their own words' — the score is in the fold and is not restated), FirmClosings as carousel, V3Atlas, Quiet #about (How it started + firm/PB license line, OREA source), V3Answers, Footer. No V3Instrument. No V3SourceLine on faces, closings, or fold proof. Dates render in Pacific through formatDate.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet and V3Instrument carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (this page opens on cream faces, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFaces
requiredComponents.section: OPENS THE PAGE, headingLevel 1, size proof. Carries the H1, a real firm beat (since 2014, Bend office, who you call works your deal), then three separate broker Cards (Matt, Rebecca, Paul) each with Avatar + AvatarImage + AvatarFallback, name, title, Call Button, ghost Text / Email / Schedule. The review count links to /reviews. Per-broker MLS record as a plain line, no methodology disclosure. No AvatarGroup overlap. Not a KPI row. Canonical /images/brokers/*.png.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Once: #about, late — a short origin plus the firm and principal-broker licences as sourced facts, never a KPI Instrument. The second instance (#who, seven contact rows as the fold) was deleted by SITE-48; the reach it carried is the V3Doors reach control.

requiredComponents.name: FirmClosings
requiredComponents.section: Recent Ryan Realty closings as V3Carousel / shadcn carousel in the first-viewport about-fold (Card slides: photo, address, recorded ClosePrice, beds/baths/sqft, listing door). As many real closings as the firm record returned. Child of the page so about/page.tsx never mounts a city-stats Ledger.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, closing. The same ABOUT_FAQ_ITEMS array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits, as native disclosures, with the three edges /about has not offered yet (Value my home, Homes for sale, Central Oregon housing market) in the left rail. Replaces the closing V3Quiet 2026-09-02: as prose it measured 1,491px at 1440 with 8 paragraphs, no figure and no control, which is the wall of text TASTE.md bans by name, and four of those paragraphs restated a section above them. The D11 mission sentence went with them — VOICE.md permits it on About and requires it nowhere, and it opened on smallness positioning. No answer moved behind script: a closed disclosure is still in the served HTML.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: The service area as the living map: every town, community, and Bend neighborhood with a recorded boundary as a door, the region's listings as dots, one claim sentence from the same population the homepage hero reads (buildPlaceAtlas, one source). Replaces the city ledger 2026-09-02 (Matt: every page interactive, no scrolling lists).

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
requiredComponents.section: The newest verified Google reviews AS WORDS, headingLevel 2, a door to /reviews. Same DAL read (getReviews) and the same quote shaping as /reviews. The count and the average are NOT the headline here — the opening already prints them, and printing them again is one page written twice.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

requiredComponents.name: V3Doors
requiredComponents.section: #reach, the one reach control. `primary` on the call door (display scale, larger bounding box) with the V3OnDuty live state and its trace under it; text, email and Schedule as the lighter alternatives. Replaces the seven-row contact list SITE-48 removed.

requiredComponents.name: V3OnDuty
requiredComponents.section: The live state on the reach control: our published booking hours against the Pacific clock, from the same crm_company_settings.booking_hours rows /book offers time from. NEVER a reply-time figure — see components/site/v3/V3OnDuty.view.ts and SITE-09.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to V3Chrome today. The KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

deferredComponents.name: V3Sheet
deferredComponents.reason: About destinations open on Quiet + Sheet, but the capture forms already live on /contact and /team/[slug]. Adding a Sheet here would be a new capture contract.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs owned media and is never allowed over a number. V3Stage is one full-bleed frame with a navy scrim, which would put a rectangle behind the transparent broker PNGs. AboutFaces does that owned-media job on cream instead.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale.

deferredComponents.name: V3Instrument
deferredComponents.reason: Licenses are one sourced Quiet line (firm + PB), not a KPI hero.

sectionOrder: about-fold -- AboutFaces proof (H1, firm beat, three broker Cards with separate Avatars) + Street View exterior of 115 NW Oregon Ave #2 + FirmClosings #firm-sales as carousel. Never the interior sofa.
V3Doors #reach -- one call door at display scale with the live hours, then text, email, calendar
V3Proof #proof -- the firm's Google reviews as words
V3Quiet #about -- how it started plus licenses as one sourced line
